تنتقشون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِشُونَ (tantaqišūna) /tan.ta.qi.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
# تُنْتَقَشُونَ (tuntaqašūna) /tun.ta.qa.ʃuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَشَ (intaqaša)
